newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill ups Barclays numbers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill ups Barclays numbers.

text.p: Bank analysts at Merrill Lynch on Wednesday joined the band of industry watchers who have upped their earnings estimates on Barclays Plc, market sources said.
For 1997, Merrill increased its pre-tax profit estimate to 2,474 million stg from 2,431 million while for 1998 it raised to 2,619 million stg from 2,556 million.

Other houses have already increased estimates, with NatWest Securities raising its 1997 pre-tax profit forecast by 50 million stg to 2,534 million stg and its 1998 estimate by a similar amount to 2,626 million stg.
Merrill repeated an "accumulate" rating on the stock, sources said. Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
